comment: The version-gate truth table. Both implementations of the rule read it: src/guide/versioning.py via tests/test_versioning.py, and web/render.js by mirroring these cases. Change a rule here and both sides must move. docs/versioning.md is the prose.

cases.why: minor behind — additive-only makes this safe
minor ahead — render, but say so
